description: NaLi₂La₃Ti₆O₁₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with five equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-2.90 Å. Li is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.04 Å. There are three inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with five equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.93 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with seven LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.98 Å. In the third La site, La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with seven LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.85 Å. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with three LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-17°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.00 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with five LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-17°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.03 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-14°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.02 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two La, and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li, one La, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent OLa₃Ti₂ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three La and two Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two La, and two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three La and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, one La, and two Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three La and two Ti atoms to form distorted OLa₃Ti₂ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent OLa₃Ti₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, three La, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li, one La, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂LaTi₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent OLa₃Ti₂ square pyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, one La, and two Ti atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two La, and two equivalent Ti atoms.
